name: quoth
note: A worked example of a product's own colour seed, and the fixture the house checks build on every change. quoth owns its copy; this one is what the house tools are tested against. tools/build.py --brand brand.seed.json --extend solves every token here against quoth's own brand set and writes quoth.tokens.css beside this file; tools/contrast.py --extend verifies it with the second instrument against tokens/tokens.css in this directory.

tokens.name: quoth-live
tokens.usage: The microphone is open and audio is being captured, and nothing else. It is a mark and never text, since quoth's D-059 took the word out of it: the lit segments of the level meter, on any of the six house surfaces, where the word and the meter's shape carry the state too, so it never rests on colour. Hue 48 at L 0.55 and 0.74 is quoth's D-062, solved at the 3:1 a mark needs; chroma is asked at 0.30 and the build clamps it to the sRGB edge, 0.1492 and 0.1687.
tokens.notFor: Text, selection, focus, a link or a chart series. Never a pulse or any other loop, and never the menu-bar item, which sits on a ground the house does not own.
